author: sp100 window-convention check 2026-08-27
why: the BAR-COUNT reading of sp100_momentum. This repo denominates windows in days, the StrategyQuant source states RSI period 2 as a bar count; the two coincide exactly on the 1d equity and ETF sheets and nowhere else, so the day-denominated 4h cells scored on 2026-08-26 are a different rule -- 60-80% position agreement and up to 6x the turnover. Registered after seeing that measurement, which is itself a look at the data and is why it is its own trial
hypothesis: null, and for the same reason the day reading was: the entry cannot fire while SMA50 is under SMA200, so the rule is structurally out of the market through every downtrend and ir_vs_random should price away whatever that buys. The bar reading trades 4-6x more often, so if anything it should score WORSE after costs
